steps.label: Distributor
steps.sub: holds the distribution database, stages changes

code:
LOG READER AGENT     runs on distributor
                      reads publisher's log continuously
                      writes commands to distribution DB

DISTRIBUTION AGENT    reads queued commands
                      applies to subscriber, in commit order
                      runs at distributor (push) or subscriber (pull)
caption: Capture and delivery are split — that seam is where problems live.

subtitle: Watching latency and agent health before it breaks.
